overture.coverage_limit: OSM footprints are an incomplete volunteer map, not a complete facility universe
overture.overlap_policy: stable IDs retained for authoritative point matching; a facility is priced once after parent matches; unmatched acres never imputed
overture.ownership_limit: operator:type government is operating evidence, not a fee-title record; unknown is retained

padus.overlap_policy: unique OBJECTID; exact duplicate geometries flagged, all positive-area tract overlaps dissolved by stable source ID
padus.scope_limit: state/local park designation does not identify only capital-bearing or saleable acres

park_tract_split.overlap_rule: subtract union of all earlier lexicographic source IDs within each tract; original site acreage determines B/C discounts
park_tract_split.pricing_rule: tract prices apply to intersected pieces, with source-site acreage retained for B/C discounts
